name: Securities Movement Status 1 Choice
definition: Provides the status of thesecurities movement.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Checks on the amount of the securities have failed for at least one security.

Cash.name: Cash
Cash.definition: Instruction is meant to cure a cash fail, but no cash fail position exists in the transaction

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: At least one security in the message does not have the same currency as the transaction and this is a requirement in the triparty agreement or in the eligibility sets of this transaction.

Excluded.name: Excluded
Excluded.definition: At least one security has been excluded from use as collateral for all transactions in the triparty agreement (or in the eligibility set).

Future.name: Future
Future.definition: Security satisfies all validation checks and can therefore be accepted for the related transaction.

Pending.name: Pending
Pending.definition: Validation checks on the security have not yet started or are still ongoing.

ManuallyAccepted.name: Manually Accepted
ManuallyAccepted.definition: Security does not satisfy the eligibility criteria stipulated in the triparty agreement. However the bank has manually accepted this security.

Eligibility.name: Eligibility
Eligibility.definition: At least one security does not satisfy the eligibility criteria as defined in the triparty agreement (or in the eligibility set) for this transaction.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: At least one security cannot be used as collateral because a tax event is due in the next few days.

Wait.name: Wait
Wait.definition: At present the security satisfies the currency and eligibility criteria checks.
